title: Rogers' egg craft resembles Lazar's sport model

tellings.quote: out as I've described with this egg. It would be very much like his sports model.

plain: The egg-shaped craft that Greg Rogers, a NASA doctor, says he saw in a secret hangar would be 'very much like' the 'sport model.' That is the name Bob Lazar gave to a disc-shaped craft. Lazar is a man who has said that in 1989 he worked on alien craft at S-4, a secret site near Area 51, the classified Air Force test base in Nevada. Rogers draws the comparison himself in telling Michels what he saw. If true, his sighting would back up Lazar's account.
